chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, who said:
I saw the Servant (peace be upon him) while he was in the state of Ihram, wearing a ring, and he was performing the obligatory Tawaf.

key_terms.إِحْرَامٌ: The state of ritual consecration for Hajj or Umrah
key_terms.الْفَرِيضَةُ: The obligatory duty (referring to the main Tawaf)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to wear a ring while in the state of Ihram during Hajj?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith provides a practical legal precedent (hujjah) for the permissibility of wearing a ring during Ihram, resolving debates on whether such adornments invalidate the ritual state. The specific mention of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) performing the obligatory Tawaf underscores the authenticity of this practice within the Ahl al-Bayt's tradition, linking physical adornment with the spiritual purity of the pilgrimage.
